title: A web window's data (window.data when window.type is "web")
description: R1, hub v0.5.0 (REACH §5.1). One page is a web window; two to six pages are a tabs window. Proposed with the window.type value "web" (see docs/contracts.md once merged).

url.description: Only http and https pages are shown; anything else is dropped by the hub UI

title.description: The page's title: the tab's word and the card's hero

site.description: Shown in the kicker as WEB // site; left out, the UI takes the host without www.

frame.description: "no": the backend knows this page can't be framed, so the card shows at once (left out = auto: try the frame, fall back to the card)

active.description: The page shown first (a page id); left out, the first page
